class.description: Converts Stage-4C predicted obstacle trajectories on /tracked_objects into uncertainty-aware future occupancy cost. Each prediction's 2x2 position covariance is eigen-decomposed into a sigma-level ellipse and rasterized with a Mahalanobis-distance-based spatial confidence and an exponential temporal weight. Combined into the master costmap with max semantics, so it can never erase static, obstacle or inflation costs.
